title: Leandro's changing story: underground citadel with stone sarcophagi
summary: Michael Mazzola tells of Leandro's changing story: underground citadel with stone sarcophagi, about 2015-2025 at Nazca region, Peru, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And so initially, he was saying, "Hey, I found this underground citadel, like almost like a temple." And they were in there and they were inside of stone sarcophagi. That was the initial story.

related.note: Same event, Leandro's discovery of the bodies, but this telling says his first version was an underground citadel or temple with stone sarcophagi, not a cave behind a collapsed wall.

plain: Michael Mazzola, a man who has looked into a set of strange three-fingered bodies said to come from the Nazca region of Peru, talked about it on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels. He says the man who claims he found the bodies, Leandro, first told it differently from his later account of finding them in a cave: at the start, Leandro said he had found an underground citadel, almost like a temple, where the bodies lay inside stone coffins. Mazzola tells it to show that Leandro's story of where the bodies came from has changed over the years.
